title: Suited beings on a scrap-metal train car, 1971

tellings.quote:
And last last night I talked with a lady
who wrote me a letter and she uh for the
first time told anyone outside her
family about something happened in 1971.
in October 1971 and she was uh bicycling
in a small city in the middle of Sweden.

plain: Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher who has gathered a huge archive of reports, says a woman recently wrote to him and then spoke with him. According to Svahn, she told someone outside her family for the first time about something that happened in October 1971, when she was cycling in a small city in central Sweden and saw beings in suits on a train car loaded with scrap metal. If true, it would be a close sighting of beings, kept quiet for fifty years.
